name: joint-set
description: Select objects associated with any of the given joint-set IDs. Selects block contacts, subcontacts and faces directly; blocks, zones and vertices if a host block has a matching contact; flow planes, flowplane zones and vertices if the flow plane contact matches.
notes: Live-checked on 3DEC 9.8.54 (2026-10-29): the cut 'joint id = 2' gives 'joint-set 2' 1 contact, 8 subcontacts and both blocks; 'joint-set 99' none.
